contents.name: Identifier
contents.description: Composite Modbus address "<RegisterType>:<PDU offset>" of the datum to write to (e.g. "HoldingRegister:100", "Coil:5") - the same syntax as the Modbus stream Identifier, restricted to the two writable address spaces: Coil and HoldingRegister. DiscreteInput/InputRegister addresses are read-only in Modbus and are rejected by the source if configured here.

contents.name: Datatype

enumValues.name: BOOL
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Boolean. Valid only with Coil addresses (1 bit).

enumValues.name: INT16
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Int16. 1 register, transported to the agent as Int32 (4 bytes) - pair with Encoding INT32.

enumValues.name: UINT16
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.UInt16. 1 register, transported to the agent as Int32 (4 bytes) - pair with Encoding INT32.

enumValues.name: INT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Int32. 2 consecutive registers, combined per the parameter's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: UINT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.UInt32. 2 consecutive registers, combined per the parameter's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: FLOAT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Single (IEEE 754). 2 consecutive registers, combined per the parameter's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: FLOAT64
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Double (IEEE 754). 4 consecutive registers, combined per the parameter's WordOrder.

contents.description: Wire-type of the value to write (e.g. "INT16") - Modbus offers no read-before-write type discovery for an arbitrary register, so the type must be configured. Token-identical to the Modbus stream's Datatype enum.

contents.name: WordOrder

enumValues.name: HighWordFirst
enumValues.comment: The register at the lower address holds the most-significant 16 bits.

enumValues.name: LowWordFirst
enumValues.comment: The register at the lower address holds the least-significant 16 bits.

contents.description: The vendor-specific register order used to combine multiple consecutive 16-bit registers into 32-/64-bit values (e.g. "HighWordFirst"). The Modbus specification fixes byte order within one register but not word order across registers - this must match the target device's convention.

contents.name: Value
contents.description: Value which will be cyclically written to the configured Modbus address, parsed to the Datatype-hinted type at write time (e.g. "1" for a Coil, "1234" for an INT16 register, "98.6" for a FLOAT32 register).
